    const receipts: unknown[] = [];
    const observerErrors: { phase: string; error: string }[] = [];
    let truncated = 0;
    const isElement = (target: EventTarget | null): target is Element =>
      target !== null && "nodeType" in target && target.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE;
    const identify = (target: EventTarget | null) => isElement(target)
      ? { tag: target.tagName, id: target.id, class: target.getAttribute("class"), label: target.getAttribute("aria-label") }
      : { kind: String(target) };
    const viewport = (host: Window) => ({
      width: host.innerWidth, height: host.innerHeight,
      visual: host.visualViewport && {
        width: host.visualViewport.width, height: host.visualViewport.height,
        offsetLeft: host.visualViewport.offsetLeft, offsetTop: host.visualViewport.offsetTop,
        scale: host.visualViewport.scale,
      },
    });
    const collect = (phase: string, event?: Event, owner: Window = window) => {
      if (receipts.length >= 200) {
        truncated++;
        return;
      }
      const style = getComputedStyle(stepper);
      const point = event && "clientX" in event && "clientY" in event
        && typeof event.clientX === "number" && typeof event.clientY === "number"
        ? { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY } : null;
      receipts.push({
        phase, time: performance.now(), coordinateSpace: owner === window ? "child" : "parent",
        event: event && {
          type: event.type, trusted: event.isTrusted, target: identify(event.target),
          containsTarget: isElement(event.target) && stepper.contains(event.target),
          point, buttons: "buttons" in event ? event.buttons : null,
          button: "button" in event ? event.button : null,
          pointerType: "pointerType" in event ? event.pointerType : null,
          hit: point && identify(owner.document.elementFromPoint(point.x, point.y)),
        },
        connected: stepper.isConnected, active: stepper.matches(":active"), hover: stepper.matches(":hover"),
        disabled: stepper.getAttribute("disabled"), dataDisabled: stepper.getAttribute("data-disabled"),
        background: style.backgroundColor, transition: style.transitionDuration,
        accent: style.getPropertyValue("--accent"), foreground: style.getPropertyValue("--foreground"),
        animations: stepper.getAnimations().map(animation => ({
          state: animation.playState, currentTime: String(animation.currentTime),
        })),
        rect: stepper.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(),
        frame: window.frameElement?.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(),
        viewport: viewport(window), parentViewport: viewport(window.parent),
        focus: document.hasFocus(), visibility: document.visibilityState,
        activeElement: identify(document.activeElement),
        parentActiveElement: identify(window.parent.document.activeElement),
        value: document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("input")?.value,
      });
    };
    const snapshot = (phase: string, event?: Event, owner: Window = window) => {
      try {
        collect(phase, event, owner);
      } catch (error) {
        observerErrors.push({ phase, error: error instanceof Error ? error.stack ?? error.message : String(error) });
      }
    };
    const events = ["pointerdown", "pointerup", "pointercancel", "mousedown", "mouseup", "focus", "blur", "visibilitychange"];
    const childListener = (event: Event) => snapshot("child-native", event);
    const parentListener = (event: Event) => snapshot("parent-native", event, window.parent);
    for (const type of events) {
      window.addEventListener(type, childListener, true);
      window.parent.addEventListener(type, parentListener, true);
    }
    try {
      snapshot("before-hover");
__ORIGINAL_BODY__
    } finally {
      snapshot("observer-finally");
      for (const type of events) {
        window.removeEventListener(type, childListener, true);
        window.parent.removeEventListener(type, parentListener, true);
      }
      await annotate("NumberField native press receipts", {
        contentType: "application/json",
        bodyEncoding: "utf-8",
        body: JSON.stringify({ receipts, observerErrors, truncated }, null, 2),
      });
      expect(observerErrors).toEqual([]);
      expect(truncated).toBe(0);
    }
